reliefwebMeta.provider: ReliefWeb API v2 / UN OCHA and original publishing organizations
reliefwebMeta.authentication: approved ReliefWeb appname supplied only as a build-time URL query parameter; its value is never written to the snapshot, registry, ledger, browser bundle, or export
reliefwebMeta.redistribution: ReliefWeb Terms & Conditions restrict redistribution and derivative compilation; materials may be owned by original sources. This artifact therefore retains only titles, identifiers, dates, taxonomy, organizations, links, status, and factual country-centroid georeferences. Report bodies, body-html, headline summaries, disaster descriptions/overviews, attachments, images, and excerpts are intentionally omitted. Users must follow the ReliefWeb/source links for narrative content and contact original sources for reuse permission.
reliefwebMeta.selection: Fetches up to 48 alert/current ReliefWeb disaster records, up to 84 latest published reports, and the public country reference table in three serial POST requests, then canonicalizes/deduplicates factual metadata and caps at 132 records. The reports query intentionally excludes body, body-html, headline, files, and images.
reliefwebMeta.caveat: ReliefWeb records are humanitarian metadata and document/disaster index entries, not verified incident points. Disaster entries group reporting and carry ReliefWeb workflow status (alert/current/past) and GLIDE/type taxonomy; report entries are situational reports, appeals, maps/infographics, analyses, or other documents as classified by the publisher-supplied ReliefWeb format field. They are never conflict incidents and are never merged into the conflict-incident lattice. Coordinates, when present, are ReliefWeb country centroids joined through the primary country reference: symbolic national placement only. ReliefWeb does not supply incident coordinates, a numeric humanitarian severity scale, casualties, displacement, or people-in-need values in the fields used here; absent values remain null/omitted and are never inferred. Editorial narrative is owned by ReliefWeb sources and is deliberately not redistributed.
reliefwebMeta.statusDetail: RELIEFWEB_APPNAME is not configured; ReliefWeb requires a pre-approved appname on every API request, so no unapproved or generic identifier was used

freshness.basis: snapshot-retrieval-time; record timestamps are separately disclosed and are not substituted for retrieval freshness
